entries.scope: Source-bound repository acceleration estimates, weighted totals and private CI publication
entries.rationale: Version 3 adds estimates against 80 lines/workday from validated existing statistics or GitHub fallback; version 1 and 2 replay remains unchanged.
readerPaths: Profile or Level-0 README -> method -> register and snapshot -> reproduction commands
entries.navigationImpact: Add a public run table and one methodology link; preserve existing profile MOTD and content order.
entries.languageStrategy: German table on both public entrypoints; equivalent English README partner and bilingual methodology/help
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS Bash entrypoint and PowerShell fixture tests; native Linux/macOS/Windows CI tests on the proposed PR head
entries.risk: Private disclosure or misleading acceleration claims; strict aggregate allowlists, weighted numeric bases, explicit coverage/source dates and a repository-estimate label enforce the boundary.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Project-statistics format, reference, window, source access, visibility or publishing permissions change.
